teacher_info.about_teacher:
I have six years of experience in teaching in general and three years of experience teaching online. I hold a TESOL Certificate and I am also a Certified Leadership Trainer. For my English language, I take a very versatile approach depending on the needs and goals of my students. I like to have an open conversation to assess my students and be able to give them feedback on what I believe we can work on.

It could be fluency improvements, writing skills, pronunciation accuracy, sentence construction, and understanding. My sessions typically involve reading practices, grammar exercises, word pronunciation and topical-based studies
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My class sessions mainly start with open conversations that allow me to learn about my student and also make an assessment of how best can help them make improvements. i like to ask the student what goals or targets they may have and also get to have a picture of what weaknesses or strengths they believe they have in English.
My approach may take a contextual or topical approach to get the student to understand the use of nouns and verbs. These go on to take a role play-based approach to help the student apply the right use of tenses, adjectives, and pronouns. I also like to take on new word challenges to teach my students new words. I also like to give pronunciation exercises

course_info.trial_description:
The trial lesson is where there is an opportunity for the student to have an experience of what a lesson with me is like. It mainly starts with open conversations that allow me to learn about my student and also make an assessment of how best can help them make improvements. I like to ask the student what goals or targets they may have and also get to have a picture of what weaknesses or strengths they believe they have in English.

The trial lesson sets the foundation and the pace for my future lessons with the student.

pro_course_detail.title: OPEN  CONVERSATION (SPEAKING & FLUENCY PRACTICE)
pro_course_detail.description:
My class sessions mainly start with open conversations that allow me to learn about my student and also make an assessment of how best can help them make improvements. I like to ask the student what goals or targets they may have.
The lesson plan carters for General English depending on the preference of the student.
In this lesson, students learn and practice vocabulary to talk about a city break. Exercises cover places to go, what to pack and how to get around a city. There is also a grammar activity on there was/there were, in which students complete.
In the lesson package, students learn the structure like, don't like, hate, love + -ing. Students listen to a short conversation about likes and dislikes. There is also an online video-aided exercise in which students watch a series of video clips and make sentences using the target language.

The third lesson introduces elementary students to the present continuous. The target language is presented in a dialogue and there are several activities in which students practice the new structure. The worksheet also presents expressions for describing typical holiday/vacation activities and revises language from previous lessons.

In the next lesson, Students define free-time activities and listen to a conversation between two people with different lifestyles. They learn how to ask present simple questions about habits and routines and how to use adverbs of frequency in their answers. Students interview their partners about exercise and food habits. There is also a short optional extension activity related to sports collocations with the verbs go, play, and do.
By the 5th lesson, Students revise and extend phrases to describe leisure activities and listen to two short interviews about how people spend their free time. The language point is (really) + like/love/hate/prefer + verb with -ing. Students practice the target language in a speaking activity and there is a short optional extension activity

pro_course_detail.title: TEST  PREPARATION ( IELTS)  & INTERVIEW PREPARATION
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson caters to students who are either preparing for their examinations such as the IELTS and the Cambridge B2 First exam or those who are preparing to attend a job interview as well as students who need to interview candidates in English.
A level placement test has been designed to be used for determining a student's level according to his/her speaking ability and categorized into one of the following: Elementary, Pre-intermediate, Intermediate, Upper intermediate-advance.
This lesson plan is designed to prepare IELTS candidates to talk about different topics in Parts 1, 2, and 3 of the IELTS Speaking test.

The lesson includes a topic on Expressing Opinions. In the IELTS speaking test, the examiner will ask for the candidate's opinions on different topics. This lesson plan gives students practice in expressing their opinions using a variety of structures
In the IELTS speaking test, the examiner might ask difficult questions and the candidate may need some time to think about how to respond. This lesson plan gives students practice in using 'time fillers' -- words and structures that allow them to buy time to think without affecting their fluency score.
For the students who will be preparing for a Job interview, the class will take the following approach:
The worksheet presents key adjectives for describing personal characteristics as well as common words and expressions used for writing a CV. Students look at a variety of typical questions that can be asked during a job interview and then listen to a dialogue between an interviewer and a candidate. The language used in the dialogue is studied and practiced through role play. 

In this dialogue-based lesson plan, students learn useful vocabulary for attending a job interview in English. The worksheet includes an article about things candidates shouldn't say during an interview.
Students identify and compare some jobs and then listen to/read a text about a typical day in the life of the workers.

pro_course_detail.title: ENGLISH FOR BEGINNERS
pro_course_detail.description: This class is meant to be an introductory package for those just starting their journey in the English language. I start out from the basics in the English Language and make them comfortable in understanding the basic rules of Speaking English. I include some basic Pronunciation Exercises, reading exercises, and Sentence Construction Exercises.

pro_course_detail.description:
Business English lessons focused on different functions of English Language useful for the work place, meetings, Business Leaders and Business Presentations. Basically, its being equipped for for any kind of situation in a business environment. I have been a business coach for startups and generally teach business language in making business presentations. I have taught Business English to over 50 students this far. Some of the things to look out for

2. Making Presentation
3. Understanding Language in Meetings
4. Conversation Practise/ Chit chat  in a Business Environment

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My students say that my lessons are fun and entertaining. Adults, as well as children, must find lessons entertaining so as to be interested in learning, which is the first step in learning faster. That's why I make the lessons fun and do several activities during the lesson so that it doesn't drag. My students also mention how quick time goes by in my lessons. 
Since I've been teaching for so long, I also know why students make certain mistakes and warn them beforehand.
Beginners do speaking activities and drills to practice the new structures; and with advanced students, I plan part of the following lesson with drills to correct mistakes they've made in the speaking activities.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Adult Beginners
pro_course_detail.description: If you are an adult beginner don't feel shy to start learning a language. I have over 20 years of experience teaching adult beginners from different countries, especially from Spain, Italy and France. I speak those languages so you can relax if you need to say something or understand something in your own language. But all nationalities are welcome. My lessons are varied and fun. You'll be happy with your progress.

pro_course_detail.title: English - All Levels
pro_course_detail.description: I have over 20 years of experience in teaching English to all levels, especially adults. I make my lessons varied and entertaining. After a short conversation with my students I pick up what they lack and/or need, so I tailor my lessons to their needs. What I also do is after teaching certain grammar topics, I make my students do oral exercises and drills with those structures so that eventually these become automatic.  I also emphasise a lot on correct pronunciation.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation + Grammar (based on your own mistakes)
pro_course_detail.description: We will practice the different grammar structures, prepositions, phrasal verbs or whatever mistakes you have made during the conversation. Therefore, these are tailored lessons where you will practice exactly what you need to correct.
